operations.detail: USO guidance is bound to the official page update dated 19 June 2026.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Every UK home and business has a legal right to request a decent affordable connection.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: A decent connection requires at least 10 Mbit/s download.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: A decent connection requires at least 1 Mbit/s upload.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: BT handles eligible USO requests outside the Hull area.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: KCOM handles eligible USO requests in the Hull area.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Applicants do not need to be existing BT or KCOM customers.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: An existing fixed-wireless service can affect whether an upgrade is needed.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: An existing satellite service can affect whether a decent connection is available.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: BT or KCOM have 30 days to confirm eligibility and estimated build cost.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Eligibility requires no access to an existing decent broadband service.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Eligibility also requires no qualifying public broadband scheme in the next 12 months.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: A decent service priced above £59.60 per month can still permit a USO request.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: The cost threshold for the applicant's network share is £3,400.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: The customer pays no build charge when their share is £3,400 or less.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: The customer may pay costs above £3,400 if they still want the connection.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: BT or KCOM conduct a survey when excess-cost work is requested.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: The excess-cost quote should be provided within 60 days.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: The new service price should match other customers on the same package.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: The universal-service package should cost no more than £59.60 per month.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Most eligible connections are expected within 12 months.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Some connections may take up to 24 months.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: A satellite alternative generally requires a dish at the property.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Router position can affect in-home speed experience.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Local busy-time demand can affect experienced speed.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: A property that is ineligible now may become eligible later.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Future public schemes may contact premises that become eligible.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: An ineligible applicant should be told how to challenge the decision.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: BT or KCOM should explain how the applicant can complain.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Eligible disputes have free access to alternative dispute resolution.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: The USO page states ADR access after eight unresolved weeks.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: ADR may be used sooner when deadlock is reached.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: An applicant need not be an existing customer to dispute eligibility.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Ofcom does not investigate individual USO complaints.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Consumer complaints can still inform Ofcom's regulatory work.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: The legal right to request does not prove current premise-level availability.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Eligibility assessment is not a measured-speed record.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: The affordability threshold is not a broadband speed value.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Network construction cost is not a property valuation field.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: A future public scheme is not current live coverage.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Satellite alternatives remain separate from fixed-line and FWA coverage fields.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: FWA alternatives remain separate from fixed-line coverage.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Eligibility is assessed by the designated provider, not inferred from postcode identity alone.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: The legal right applies to homes and businesses.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: The obligation combines technical decency and affordability conditions.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: A USO connection is initiated by a request rather than automatic construction.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026

operations.detail: Ineligible applicants should be given available alternatives.
operations.source: Ofcom broadband universal service guide, updated 19 June 2026
